ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says 'Then he turned away, deliberating'?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this phrase is often linked to the hypocrites (Munafiqun) or specific figures like Abu Jahl who, upon hearing the call to prayer or the truth, hurriedly turned away to avoid submission, illustrating the urgency of their spiritual flight. The term 'yas'a' (he hastened) implies a deliberate, active effort to distance oneself from divine guidance, contrasting with the patient endurance of the faithful. This reaction underscores the concept of 'fitrah' being overridden by ego, a key theme in understanding the psychological state of the disbelievers in Mecca.
